'''Padrus Organa''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who was a member of [[House of Organa/Legends|House Organa]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]]. In [[3643 BBY]], he was kidnapped by Imperial forces.
